# SmartCounter
> AI-powered people counting and visitor analytics platform for retail stores, malls, and shopping centers in Indonesia. Uses existing CCTV cameras with computer vision and deep learning for 99.9% accurate visitor counting, heatmaps, demographics, queue detection, and occupancy monitoring.

## Company
- PT Ritel Data Indonesia
- Founded in Jakarta, Indonesia
- Serves 300+ retail locations across Indonesia
- Contact: info@riteldata.id | +62 882-1001-9165

## Core Product
SmartCounter transforms existing CCTV cameras into AI-powered visitor analytics sensors. No additional hardware required. Works with Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview, and other IP cameras.

## Key Features
- [Visitor Traffic](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/visitor-traffic): Real-time entry/exit counting with 99.9% accuracy
- [In/Out Traffic](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/in-out-traffic): Separate entry and exit counts across all entrances
- [Dwell Time](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/dwell-time): Measure time spent in specific zones
- [Heatmap](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/heatmap): Visualize visitor movement patterns
- [Demographic](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/demographic): Privacy-compliant age and gender estimation
- [Queuing](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/queuing): Real-time queue length and wait time monitoring
- [Occupancy](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/occupancy): Real-time occupancy monitoring with safety alerts
- [In-Store Routes](https://smartcounter.id/en/features/in-store-routes): Track visitor paths through your store

## Industry Solutions
- [Retail Store](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases/retail): Conversion rate, staffing optimization, layout analytics
- [Shopping Mall](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases/mall): Tenant benchmarking, zone traffic, revenue-based leasing
- [Fashion Retail](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases/fashion): Fitting room conversion, collection performance
- [Pharmacy](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases/pharmacy): Prescription queue monitoring, scheduling
- [Supermarket](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases/supermarket): Aisle analytics, checkout queue management
- [Luxury Retail](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases/luxury): Privacy-first VIP analytics

## Key Facts
- 99.9% counting accuracy using YOLO + DeepSORT algorithms
- Works with existing CCTV infrastructure (no new hardware)
- Privacy-first: no face recognition, no personal data stored
- Real-time dashboard accessible via browser and mobile
- 5 languages supported: English, Indonesian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese
- Typical ROI: 2-3 months payback, 15-25% sales increase in first 6 months
